15. REMOVE NO. 3 CLUTCH HUB AND 5TH GEAR
(a) Using 2 screwdrivers and a hammer, tap out the snap
ring.

clearance of the No. 3 clutch hub less than 0.1 mm (0.0039 in.).

(b) Using a screwdriver, remove the shifting key spring from
the No. 3 clutch hub.
{c) Install a bolt and washer to the tip of the input shaft and
using SST, remove the No. 3 clutch hub.
SST 09950--30011
HINT:
Select a bolt whose outer diameter is smaller than the screw
hole of the input shaft so that it can be turned easily.
(d) Remove the No. 3 synchronizer ring, 5th gear, needle roll­
er bearing and spacer.
